title: kbmon's landing_steps ignores every land.step of an item that once landed with exit 0, so a reopened item's second landing never shows
goal: mon_sessions.landing_steps ignores a land.step row only when a land.end of exit 0 for the same item comes after it, so a reopened item's later landing shows as in landing (SP-fn7letri review G6 on ST-kxnlpycw; the operator's g1 answer).

run: import inspect,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_sessions as m;s=inspect.getsource(m.landing_steps);print('ended' in s and 'ended.discard' not in s and 'ended.remove' not in s);sys.exit(1 if 'ended' in s and 'ended.discard' not in s and 'ended.remove' not in s else 0)

repro_reason: landing_steps reads the clone's ops rows; planting rows needs a spool fixture, so the repro reads the function for a permanent per-item ended set
